subject: SCIENCE
title: Classify the Animals
objective: Classify animals by observable traits and explain the chosen rule.
introduction: A learner-made group is an observation tool, not formal biological taxonomy. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: To sort things into groups that are alike.
A living thing that can move and needs food.
A feature or quality a living thing has.

activities.instruction: Explore each example, then read the examples.

activities.instruction: Sort each card: does it follow the chosen grouping rule?

feedback.correct: Your groups match what we learned.

feedback.correct: Correct: has feathers or no feathers

activities.instruction: Match each example to the lesson idea.
